'''Muir''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The assistant to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Viktus]], he was stationed at [[Outpost Ghrent]] in the [[Glarus Valley]].
